method: 24 proper rotations (axis permutation x sign, det=+1) + translation of PM centroid to LV centroid; score = fraction of PM vertices inside LV
verdict: NOT RECOVERED. The best rotation scores 0.852 but the 5th-best scores 0.807: a spread of 0.044 across rotations means the inside-fraction metric does not identify the rotation at all -- a ~50 mm blob centred in a ~70 mm cavity is mostly inside under ANY proper rotation. The earlier 'RECOVERED' came from a 0.85 threshold crossed by 0.0015 and is withdrawn. Recovery needs a registration with an anatomical constraint (PM bases on the LV free-wall endocardium, tips toward the mitral annulus), which in turn needs the mitral valve position verified first.
